Aplikacja trzęsie się i pulsuje w rytm m: The app shakes and pulses to the beat of heavy bass.
• wykrywa uderzenia basu w czasie rzeczy:
• detects bass hits in real time (20–150 Hz)
• three effects: shake, pulse and both at once
• choose what moves: the whole app, the cover or the player
• adjust effect strength and sensitivity – from a gentle sway to an earthquake
• accent flash on the strongest hits
Works with all sources: YouTube, Spotify and local files.
Pokazuje na Discordzie, czego słuchasz w: Shows on Discord what you're listening to in JustMusic, and lowers the music when someone talks in a voice channel.
• status „Słucha” z tytułem, wykonawcą,:
• “Listening” status with title, artist, cover and time bar
• “Listen on YouTube” button on your profile
• mini panel in the player with a status preview: Active / Private / Do not disturb
• JustMusic name and logo in your status (“Listening to JustMusic”)
• private mode (just “listening to music”) and hiding the status when paused
• automatic ducking when someone talks in a voice channel – on Linux by sound (works with Vesktop/Vencord, no sign-in), on Windows/macOS via the official Discord client
• AFK status together with the GoToSleep plugin, and with the “CanWeListenTogether” plugin – 👥 and the number of listeners
Connects by itself: just have Discord running (or Vesktop with arRPC enabled). When Discord is closed or restarted, JustMusic reconnects within 5 seconds.
24 dodatkowe motywy kolorystyczne, gener: 24 extra color themes, a theme generator and colors matched to the cover.
• 24 nowe motywy – ciemne, jasne, pastel:
• 24 new themes – dark, light, pastel, neon and high contrast
• generator: a random theme with one click (with saturation control)
• a whole theme generated from the current track's cover
• optionally: a new accent color for every track
The new themes appear in Settings → Theme and colors.
Gdy nie ma Cię przy komputerze przez 3 m: When you're away from the computer for 3 minutes, the music gradually fades and you get an AFK status.
• wykrywa brak aktywności myszy i klawia:
• detects mouse and keyboard inactivity across the whole system (3 minutes by default) – also on Linux with Wayland (KDE, GNOME, Hyprland, Sway)
• smoothly lowers the music and can stop it at the end
• shows an “AFK” badge in the app and – with the Discord plugin – a 💤 AFK status on Discord
• restores the volume when you're back and (optionally) resumes playback
• you can also turn AFK mode on manually (an action you can bind in OhManyKeybinds)
Zsynchronizowane teksty piosenek – aktua: Synced song lyrics – the current line lights up to the rhythm of the music.

• the lyrics scroll by themselves and highlight the current line
• click a line to jump to that moment of the track

Adds a “Lyrics” view to the menu and a microphone button to the player.
Przypisz własny skrót klawiszowy do każd: Assign your own keyboard shortcut to any action in the app – also globally, when the window is hidden.
• ponad 40 akcji: odtwarzanie, głośność,:
• over 40 actions: playback, volume, likes, bookmarks, navigation, panel layout, themes, window…
• record a shortcut with a single key press
• global shortcuts (work in the background, e.g. in a game)
• conflict warnings
• option to disable JustMusic's default shortcuts
• actions added by other plugins can be bound too
Note: on Linux with Wayland, global shortcuts depend on support from the desktop environment.
Zatrzymaj muzykę po 15, 30, 60 minutach: Stop the music after 15, 30, 60 minutes or after the current track.
Przycisk księżyca w odtwarzaczu ustawia: The moon button in the player sets a countdown. During the last 15 seconds the volume fades smoothly, and then the music stops. You can also set a custom time or “after this track”.
Słuchaj muzyki ze znajomymi w tym samym: Listen to music with friends at the same moment – like a shared speaker over the internet. All you need is a room code.
• tworzysz pokój jednym kliknięciem i wy:
• create a room with one click and send your friends an 8-character code
• guests hear exactly what you hear – track, pause and seeking are synced to a fraction of a second
• works with YouTube, Spotify and files from disk (guests get them automatically from YouTube)
• list of listeners, queue preview and flying reactions 🔥❤️😂
• guests can suggest tracks and, if you allow it, also control playback
• with the Discord plugin your status shows “Listening together”
• no accounts and no server to install – messages are encrypted with the room code
Pełnoekranowa wizualizacja muzyki – słup: Full-screen music visualization – bars, wave, circle and mirror.
Animacja reaguje na dźwięk w czasie rzec: The animation reacts to sound in real time and uses your theme's colors. Four modes and sensitivity control. Works with every source: YouTube, Spotify and local files.
Widżety i popupy z tym, co teraz gra – z: Widgets and popups showing what's playing – always on top, with your own look.
Pokazuje aktualny utwór w małych widżeta:
Shows the current track in small desktop widgets that are always on screen (above other windows and on every virtual desktop).
• 5 layouts: card, vertical, bar, cover only, text only
• choose what's visible: cover, title, artist, album, progress, time, buttons, heart, next track
• preset styles (glass, neon, retro, terminal…) or your own colors, font, size, rounding, shadow, cover background
• position: a screen corner or edge with a margin, or drag it with the mouse
• click-through, hiding while paused, several widgets at once
• popups: on a new track, after a keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+W by default) and on volume change, pause and seeking – with animation and your own style
• editor with live preview (“Widgets” menu)
Requires JustMusic 1.4.0 or newer.

Aplikacja trzęsie się i pulsuje w rytm p: The app shakes and pulses to the rhythm of the song or heavy bass.
• wykrywa tempo piosenki (BPM) i trzęsie:
• detects the song tempo (BPM) and shakes the app on every beat – even in tracks without heavy bass
• “Bass hits” mode: reacts to sudden bass spikes in real time
• works at any volume (automatic gain), also with volume normalization
• three effects: shake, pulse and both at once
• choose what moves: the whole app, the cover or the player
• adjust effect strength and sensitivity – from a gentle sway to an earthquake
• accent flash on the strongest hits
Works with all sources: YouTube, Spotify and local files.
